items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Me, and Joe Comfort, and James Nelson, Hawk, Lorenzo, myself on drums and Doris Lathy on guitar.

ctx.x: Me, and Joe Comfort, and James Nelson, Hawk, Lorenzo, myself on drums and Doris Lathy on guitar. Anyway to make a long story short, I got drafted. There was only three of us. They sent us to Fort McLellan, Alabama. Me, Joe (Unintelligible), I forget this other guy’s name, but anyway they sent us there. Like I said, it’s the first time I’d ever seen that many black soldiers.
Because there’s still a segregated army if we’re talking about the early ‘40s, right.
